name: Dependencies
excerpt: Dependencies define the relationship between project tasks.
notes: Dependencies are categorized by reason (mandatory, discretionary, external, internal) and type (finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish). They dictate the order and conditions under which tasks are performed.
context_summary: - Categorized by reason: mandatory, discretionary, external, internal.
- Categorized by type: finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish.
- Dictate order and conditions for task performance.
